blocks.text: The awakened's city, rebuilt in the New City update (2026-10-31) after Seoul: about 2,000 by 1,800 studs of quarters (Namsan, Mapo, Myeongdong, Seongsu, Bukchon, Jongno, Gangnam, the Han river), the Awakened Plaza at its heart. Its quarters form 4 danger zones, from the Docks to the Industrial Zone; rifts open on their squares and a few monsters roam the streets. The Colosseum, the Endless Tower and the training grounds stand in the city and are entered on foot; 25 free transit kiosks link every place, and the city map (key M) marks them all. Day 12 min, night 8 min.
